mission.headline: Why Rescan exists
mission.body:
Buildings are rarely as they appear on paper. Drawings go out of date. Renovations happen without documentation. When projects begin from outdated information, the cost compounds — in delays, revisits, and rework.

Rescan was founded to solve that. We capture buildings as they actually are, and deliver structured digital models that teams can rely on — not just for the current project, but for every one that follows.

detail.body: Carlqvist Property needed consistent as-built documentation across their entire portfolio of 56 commercial properties. We delivered structured 3D scans and BIM models for every site, creating a unified digital foundation for ongoing facility management and future renovation projects.

project1.title: OMYA Industrial Plant
project1.description: Full plant digitisation for retrofit planning.

detail.body: OMYA required precise documentation of their production facility to plan a major equipment retrofit. We captured the entire plant with millimetre-level accuracy, enabling the engineering team to design new installations without costly site revisits.

INGKA Group required consistent building documentation across 14 retail locations to support their sustainability and renovation programmes. We established a standardised scanning methodology and delivered uniform digital models for every site.

project5.title: Vida Timber Mill

detail.body: Vida planned a major expansion of their timber processing line and needed precise documentation of the existing facility. coreRisk.headline: When you manage multiple properties, small errors don't stay small.
coreRisk.body:
Across a property portfolio, building documentation is rarely consistent.
Some properties have updated drawings. Some don't.
Measurements differ. Standards vary between assets.
When a project begins, consultants often need to reinterpret existing documentation or return to site to verify conditions.
For one building this is manageable.
Repeated across 15, 30 or 50 properties, it becomes recurring cost, delay and frustration.

friction.headline: Why this cycle repeats across property portfolios
friction.body:
In many portfolios, building documentation is only updated when a project forces the issue.
A refurbishment begins. A technical upgrade is planned. Or consultants discover the drawings cannot be trusted.
Only then is the building measured or documented again.
This approach works for a single project.
Across a portfolio, it means the same verification work returns every time something changes.

point0.title: Stop sending teams back to site to verify drawings
point0.description:
When properties are spread across cities or regions, verification usually means travel.
High-accuracy 3D capture allows verified building conditions to be reviewed remotely — without returning to site.
Teams can check dimensions, layouts and systems from the office before work begins.

point1.title: Stop rediscovering the building every time a project starts
point1.description:
Many projects begin with the same question: "Do we actually have reliable drawings for this building?"
If the answer is uncertain, teams return to site to measure spaces, verify dimensions and check building systems.
When exact digital documentation already exists, projects can start immediately from verified building conditions.

point2.title: Give consultants models they can actually work with
point2.description:
Many as-built models are delivered as a single combined file. In practice, this creates coordination problems.
When required, RESCAN structures models by discipline — architecture, plumbing, ventilation and electrical — delivered in Revit or Archicad to match consultant workflows.

strategicValue.headline: One verified foundation. Every project starts from known conditions.

valueA.title: Clear building documentation across the entire portfolio
valueA.description:
Each property is documented using the same structure and standards.
Asset managers and technical teams can access reliable building documentation for every site — not a mix of outdated drawings and inconsistent files.
This makes it easier to understand building conditions, plan upgrades and manage properties across the portfolio.
Instead of uncertainty, teams work from consistent documentation across all locations.

valueB.title: Future projects start from known conditions
valueB.description:
When refurbishment or upgrade projects begin, consultants and internal teams can start from verified building documentation.
Instead of re-measuring buildings or interpreting outdated drawings, projects begin with accurate existing conditions.
If buildings change over time, the documentation can be updated rather than recreated from scratch.
This reduces uncertainty and helps projects move faster.

namedCase.label: Portfolio case
namedCase.headline: Carlqvist Property — 56 commercial properties documented across Sweden
namedCase.body:
Carlqvist Property contacted RESCAN to document its portfolio of 56 commercial properties across Sweden.
The objective was not a single renovation project, but to create reliable documentation across the entire portfolio.
Each property was captured and structured into accurate digital building documentation, creating a consistent reference point for the portfolio.
namedCase.bullet1: review building layouts and dimensions remotely
namedCase.bullet2: reduce repeated site visits during renovation and upgrade projects
namedCase.bullet3: start projects from verified building documentation
namedCase.quote: Consistent documentation across all properties saves us both time and money. It gives us a clear overview of the portfolio and removes a lot of uncertainty when planning changes.
